plan.title: Counter Offer Remains Pending During Evaluation

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Responses screen with the existing vendor bid.
Send the buyer's counter offer on the vendor's own bid at the requested price and remark.
Verify the buyer's grid marks the counter offer as initiated.
Verify the counter offer remains pending on the buyer side.
Switch to Vendor A's supplier-portal session while leaving the buyer session available.
Open the RFQ pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify the vendor sees the pending counter offer without taking an answer action.

args.text: You have a counter offer pending on this bid

steps.note: Verify the vendor-side restriction preventing a revision while the counter offer is pending.
Return to the buyer's session after leaving the vendor's counter offer unanswered.
Verify the counter offer is still pending after the vendor takes no action.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison.
Verify the comparison retains Vendor A's original bid price of 100.
